data.name: STEEL LINE
data.detailed_description:
What is the STEEL LINE? It is a monolithic, unexplainable structure that defies the laws of nature and reality. You are going in to uncover its darkest secrets - if you can survive the descent.

STEEL LINE is a relentless rogue-like FPS that blends the frenetic, room-by-room clearing of classic dungeon crawlers with visceral, physics-driven gunplay. Every run is a unique descent into an unpredictable anomaly. You begin with basic weaponry, but as you delve deeper, you will mutate your arsenal and abilities into something monstrous.

Key Features

  • Game-Breaking Synergies: Survival requires more than just a good trigger finger. Discover a massive arsenal of weapons and combine them with an ever-expanding pool of Trinkets, Active items, and Passive items. Stack their effects to create wild, run-defining synergies that completely alter your playstyle.

  • Ever-Changing Anomalies: No two runs are the same. Battle your way through procedurally generated floors built from a vast pool of handcrafted rooms. Adapt your tactics as you descend through distinct, atmospheric zones:

    • The Laboratory: Cold, sterile, and crawling with contained nightmares that have breached their cells.

    • The Temple: A corrupted, gothic sanctuary harboring fanatical horrors.

    • The Dump: A rotting, subterranean abyss of discarded machinery and biological waste.

  • Visceral Combat & Dismemberment: Feel the impact of every shot. Enemies don't just soak up damage - they break apart. Blast off limbs, shatter armor, and paint the walls with a brutal, dynamic dismemberment system.

  • The World is Your Weapon: The environment inside the STEEL LINE is highly reactive and fully interactable. Kick physics objects into enemies, trigger explosive hazards, and use the shifting architecture of the facility to your tactical advantage.

data.short_description: Descend into a randomly generated rogue-like FPS where no two runs are the same. Explore the anomalous STEEL LINE, stacking powerful items and weapons to create wild synergies. Use highly reactive environments to your advantage and brutally destroy the horrors that await below.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-8400 / AMD® Ryzen™ 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GTX™ 1050 Ti / AMD® Radeon™ RX 560
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 11 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-13600KF / AMD® Ryzen™ 7 7700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® RTX™ 3060 / AMD® Radeon™ Radeon RX 6600
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
